description: The first Vibe Claiming MCP: AI agents scan and reclaim dormant SOL on Solana. Signs locally.
name: io.github.nedim1511/unclaimed-sol

environmentVariables.description: Path to a Solana keypair JSON file. Enables Vibe Claiming (claim tools).
environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_KEYPAIR_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Alternative to SOLANA_KEYPAIR_PATH (base58 or JSON byte array). Prefer the keypair path.
environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Solana RPC endpoint. Defaults to the public mainnet-beta RPC.
environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Backend API URL. Defaults to https://unclaimedsol.com.
environmentVariables.name: UNCLAIMED_SOL_API_URL
